definition.label: I-405 Jamboree - screenshot foreground carriageway
definition.notes: Count only the finite screenshot line across the foreground carriageway in Pre-position 1, from the median to the right verge. Exclude the opposing carriageway, frontage roads, buildings and pavement before tracking. Increment only on a confirmed bottom-centre line crossing in capture UTC; a detection or ROI entry alone never counts. Published round definitions and all capture-clock, coverage, framing and tracking checks remain intact.
